_tagline_notes: THE tagline, and the reason this file exists: it appeared in three places
(the header, the hero headline, the footer) and changing it meant hunting
for all three. Now it lives here and scripts/apply-brand.py writes it into
every element marked data-brand="tagline". Edit the JSON, run the script.
Never type it into the HTML by hand — apply-brand.py --check will catch it.
It went back to 'A quiet place for letters.' on 2026-08-23. The redesign
had replaced it with 'A private desk for digital letters.', which says what
the thing IS but is not ownable — any stationery app could print it. The
quiet-place line is warmer, more memorable, and the one a person repeats.
It is not lost work: the private-desk sentence is still the hero's second
line, where saying what it is belongs, so the pair does both jobs.
The period is part of the string. It reads as a sentence in the hero and as
a small full stop under the wordmark, and one canonical form beats a rule
about where punctuation is added.
RETIRED 2026-09-24 (Patrick): 'A quiet place for letters.' A mood rather than
a reason - a parent scrolling on a phone could not tell it was for kids or what
it replaced. The brand line is now 'Letters, not texts.', and it CLOSES the
homepage (the closing section's heading carries data-brand="tagline"). The
hero headline is no longer the tagline: it is 'Kids can keep in touch without
texting.' over the one line that says what the app does, 'Write and draw
digital letters with friends and family.' Typed by hand in index.html, because
it is a headline, not a repeated brand string. It was 'Kids can stay close
without texting.' (the ads' hook) until Patrick asked: close to whom?

_beta_cta_notes: RETIRED with the private beta. It read 'Request an invite', and before
that 'Join private beta' and 'Get Started'; its note always said it would
change 'the day the beta ends'. What replaced it is not another string but
an OBJECT — Apple's App Store badge, whose artwork may not be modified or
relettered, so there is no longer a label for a script to write. The four
buttons it fed became badge links; what varies between them is the href,
Kept as a note rather than deleted so the next person to read this file
learns where the four data-brand="beta_cta" markers went.
